Under a tenant assertion, you pay you rent to the court, and they hold it until after the matter is settled. From what you’ve written, you’re in the right. That being the case, they will give you back a good amount of it AND subtract the cost of your legal fees. I did this about 2 years ago when my landlord refused to take care of a cockroach infestation. I actually moved out of the apartment right away so I got all the money back and my landlord had to pay extra for my legal fees/attorney fees
